author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Greetings Avicus Staff members

I am YouCantCMe better known as Zac. The infraction I am appealing is a TeamSpeak ban for Toxic Behavior. I believe this ban should be appealed as Toxic behavior violates no rules. If the real reason for the ban is racism (which I believe it is) then I would like to point out that several staff members including Mango_ and Administrafer told me racism was allowed, other staff members also allowed me to be racist without warnings/kicks so it would be reasonable for me to assume it was legal. I would also like to point out that racism which used to be specifically indicated as something that wasn't allowed in 18+ was removed from the list of things not allowed, therefore most players would be likely to assume it is now allowed. In fact when the initial infraction for racism was given out Administrafer appealed me saying that racism is allowed in 18+ as long as I didn't target specific users repeatably. While 18+ does follow 3 guidelines I broke none of these guidelines as I neither spammed, trolled or bullied. While trolling and spamming seem rather straight up I have heard racism related to bullying. I would like to correct this as bullying is defined as use superior strength or influence to intimidate (someone), typically to force him or her to do what one wants. Therefore unless I am being accused of hoping the words I said to reach a party which I was addressing (I didn't address the insults to anyone) to force a reaction from that person and some satisfaction from me this cannot be considered bullying. Even If I did say these things and they reached a party who I meant to describe with it (even though I didn't) this would qualify as gossip unless there is evidence I wanted it to reach the person/party and took steps to ensure it did. I miss my friends on TS and would like to get back to hanging out with them.Thanks for your time.

Sincerely, Zac

replies.body: 29 views and 4 days later... Hi guys! It's zac, since no Sr staff member has made a decision, provided evidence or corrected me on my interpretation of the rules can I get appealed now?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Racism is a violation of the rules. It's been clarified to you. It's also not permitted to target a certain race, sex, or have any form of discrimination. As well as being a former staff member, you should be aware of what may be questionable or not to say. That, for which, you have had "troll-like" behavior in which we don't welcome.

Your appeal you has been denied. Also, insulting the staff won't make your appeal go quicker.
